about: Licence policy for scripts/licence_scan.py --check (F3). `allowed`: SPDX ids a dependency may carry without review. `exceptions`: packages whose copyleft, proprietary or unknown licence was reviewed. Each records the licence it was reviewed under (a change fails the check) and why it is acceptable; `notice` is the text NOTICE carries for it; `owner_decision: true` marks an exception that is in place only so CI stays green and still needs the owner's sign-off. A new copyleft or unknown dependency fails CI until it is reviewed here.

pypi:certifi.why: Weak, file-level copyleft. Used unmodified as a library (CA bundle for requests/httpx/snowflake). Obligation: keep its notices and say where its source is.

pypi:orjson.why: Pulled in by trino. Weak, file-level copyleft (MPL-2.0 parts). Used unmodified as a library.
pypi:orjson.notice: MPL-2.0 AND (Apache-2.0 OR MIT), used unmodified. Source: https://github.com/ijl/orjson

pypi:paramiko.why: SFTP connector. LGPL library used unmodified and loaded as a separate, user-replaceable Python package. Redistributing it in the API image needs its licence text and source location.
pypi:paramiko.notice: LGPL-2.1, used unmodified as a separately replaceable library. Source: https://github.com/paramiko/paramiko

pypi:psycopg2-binary.why: PostgreSQL connector. LGPL-3.0 with exceptions. Used unmodified as a separate library. The binary wheel bundles libpq (PostgreSQL Licence) and OpenSSL.
pypi:psycopg2-binary.notice: LGPL-3.0 (with the psycopg2 exceptions), used unmodified as a separately replaceable library; the wheel bundles libpq and OpenSSL. Source: https://github.com/psycopg/psycopg2

pypi:pymssql.why: SQL Server fallback driver. LGPL-2.1. Used unmodified as a separate library. The wheel bundles FreeTDS (LGPL).
pypi:pymssql.notice: LGPL-2.1, used unmodified as a separately replaceable library; the wheel bundles FreeTDS (LGPL-2.0). Source: https://github.com/pymssql/pymssql

pypi:hdbcli.why: SAP HANA client, proprietary (SAP Developer License Agreement). Whether SAP's terms allow shipping it inside the production image is not established. Owner decision: keep it, make it an operator-installed optional driver, or remove it.
pypi:hdbcli.notice: Proprietary SAP licence. Not yet cleared for redistribution: see the owner decision in docs/legal/third-party-licences.md

pypi:teradatasql.why: Teradata SQL driver, proprietary licence. Whether its terms allow shipping it inside the production image is not established. Owner decision: keep it, make it optional, or remove it.
pypi:teradatasql.notice: Proprietary Teradata licence. Not yet cleared for redistribution: see the owner decision in docs/legal/third-party-licences.md

pypi:pypdfium2.why: PDF rendering. The bindings are BSD-3-Clause / Apache-2.0. The bundled PDFium binary carries the licences of its own dependencies (FreeType, libjpeg-turbo, OpenJPEG, LittleCMS, zlib, ICU, abseil, ...), which ship in the wheel's licence folder. All are permissive.
pypi:pypdfium2.notice: BSD-3-Clause / Apache-2.0; the bundled PDFium binary's third-party licences ship in the wheel (pypdfium2 *.dist-info/licenses). Source: https://github.com/pypdfium2-team/pypdfium2

pypi:hypothesis.why: Test tool only (requirements-dev.txt). Not in the production image, so not distributed.

npm:@fontsource/ibm-plex-mono.why: Font, OFL-1.1: may be bundled, not sold on its own. Its copyright and licence must accompany it.
